move: toggle snaps on with knob stretch, check draws, snaps off again
how: A settings card with three rows; the top 'Notifications' toggle is the actor. Cursor arrives with power3.out in the first 17% of the 4s loop. Snap on at 0.9s (22%): the toggle dips scale 0.94 then rebounds with elastic.out(1,0.5); the background tweens grey to green with power2.inOut; the knob stretches scaleX 1.3, slides 56px with back.out(2.2) over 0.32s and relaxes with elastic.out(1,0.4); a check mark inside the knob draws via strokeDashoffset 30 to 0 with power2.out; the ON text slides in from x -20 while OFF slides out to +20 with power3.out. The cursor follows the knob. At 2.5s (62%) the same sequence runs in reverse to grey/off, and the cursor exits by 3.9s.
adapt: Change the row labels, the green on-colour, and knob travel D (width - knob - 10); the two static rows are decoration. Keep the 0.32s back.out(2.2) knob slide and the elastic relax.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the card rows, the main toggle (txt on/off, knob with svg check) and cursor inside el; set the check dasharray. animate returns the timeline with snaps at 0.225D and 0.625D and cursor legs at 0.275D, 0.675D, exit 0.825D. Selectors '.main', '.txt', '.cursor' scoped to el; kx/ky derived from layout constants should come from the toggle's offset.
caveats: backgroundColor is tweened, which needs GSAP's CSS colour interpolation (present in core)
